features.name: Choose accelerometer
features.description: Lets the user pick which accelerometer (Standard/Linear/etc.) subsequent scenarios use, via a ComboBox.
expected_behaviour: A 'Choose the accelerometer to be used by the other scenarios.' description is shown
A ComboBox (default selection 'Standard') is present and enabled

features.name: Data events
features.description: Registers a ReadingChanged listener and shows X/Y/Z values; gated by Enable/Disable buttons.
expected_behaviour: Enable and Disable buttons are present
An output region for reading values is present
With no accelerometer hardware, Status shows 'Standard accelerometer not found' and buttons are disabled

features.name: Shake events
features.description: Registers a Shaken listener and displays a cumulative shake count; gated by Enable/Disable.
expected_behaviour: Enable and Disable buttons are present
Status shows 'Standard accelerometer not found' when no hardware is present

features.name: Polling
features.description: Polls the accelerometer at an interval and displays X/Y/Z values; gated by Enable/Disable.
expected_behaviour: Enable and Disable buttons are present
A 'No data' output placeholder is shown
Status shows 'Standard accelerometer not found' when no hardware is present

features.name: Orientation change
features.description: Uses ReadingTransform to show accelerometer readings with and without display-orientation transformation.
expected_behaviour: Enable and Disable buttons are present
'Untransformed:' and 'Transformed to DisplayOrientation:' sections each show 'No data'
Status shows 'Standard accelerometer not found' when no hardware is present

features.name: Data events batching
features.description: Registers a ReadingChanged listener with a report latency (batching) and displays X/Y/Z values; gated by Enable/Disable.
expected_behaviour: Enable and Disable buttons are present
An output region for reading values is present
Status shows 'Standard accelerometer not found' when no hardware is present
